package.name: uavx_roles
package.description:
The half of the role protocol that moves an aircraft.
The election lives in uavx_comms and every router carries one, so nothing here opens an epoch, ranks a bid or computes a slot. What was missing was the other half: a grant is a message, and flying because of one is a decision about an aircraft. This package keeps the grants addressed to one vehicle, refuses the stale and the misaddressed, decides where that leaves the aircraft, and writes what its role did so the run record reads the answer off the vehicle rather than off the process that ran the election.
The lease is why a dead epoch owner is recoverable. Renewals stop, the grant expires on its own, and the vehicle goes back to what it was doing with nothing to detect and no message to wait for.
